tools.name: echo
tools.title: Echo
tools.description: Echo the input text back to the caller. Useful for verifying connectivity to the HaiEduTech MCP server.

tools.name: list_courses
tools.title: List HaiEduTech courses
tools.description: List all learning tracks available on HaiEduTech (IELTS, TOEIC, HSK, Vietnamese, Finnish, Swedish, programming, scholarships, etc.) with URLs and short descriptions.

filter.description: Optional substring to filter course id / title / description (case-insensitive).

tools.name: get_vff_curriculum
tools.title: Vietnamese for Foreigners curriculum
tools.description: Return the Vietnamese for Foreigners (VFF) curriculum overview: CEFR levels A1/A2/B1 with topics, plus all skill labs (pronunciation, listening, reading, writing, roleplay AI, flashcards, culture, video, placement, analytics).

level.description: Optional: return only one CEFR level.
